{{Quote|I'm sending this message on behalf of my master, Senator Avi Singh of Raxus. The senator has been seized by Imperial authorities and is in grave danger. We require your assistance.|GS-8|<ref name="Common Ground" />}}
'''GS-8''' was an [[RA-7 protocol droid]] who served [[Senator]] [[Avi Singh]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[planet]] [[Raxus Secundus]]. Following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the planet fell under Imperial occupation, led by [[Captain]] [[Bragg]]. After Singh was [[Prison|imprisoned]] for speaking out against the occupation, GS-8 escaped, calling for help. The [[Information broker|informant]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] received the message, sending the unit of former [[clone commando]]s known as the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] to meet with GS-8 outside the [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Raxulon]]. The Bad Batch entered Singh's residence and rescued the senator, escaping in an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]]. Though they were pursued by Imperial forces, they managed to return to the Bad Batch's [[starship]], [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']], and escaped from Raxus. GS-8 and Singh accompanied the Bad Batch to [[Ord Mantell]], where they met with Scaleback, who inquired about payment.<ref name="Common Ground" />

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
GS-8 appeared in "[[Common Ground]],"<ref name="Common Ground" /> the tenth episode of the series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', released on [[Disney+]] on [[July 2]], [[2021]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-july-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in July 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> She was voiced by [[Sian Clifford]]. In one shot of the episode's opening scene, GS-8 is depicted as standing behind Captain Bragg despite previously having fled as Singh was subdued.<ref name="Common Ground" />
